rule.block.collectable.desc: When enabled, use /ec c BlockCollectable <blockId> true|false to set whether a block is collectable, or /ec c BlockCollectable reset to restore all to vanilla.
rule.block.explosion_resistance.desc: When enabled, use /ec c BlockExplosionResistance <blockId> <resistance> to set a block's explosion resistance, or /ec c BlockExplosionResistance reset to restore all to vanilla.
rule.block.mining_resistance.desc: When enabled, use /ec c BlockMiningResistance <blockId> <resistance> to set a block's destroy time, or /ec c BlockMiningResistance reset to restore all to vanilla.
rule.block.strong_power.desc: Make the specified blocks act as redstone conductors, so they can be powered by redstone components like dirt or stone and pass the powered state to adjacent redstone dust.
rule.entity.no_spawn.desc: Entity types on this list are never spawned again: natural spawning, spawners, spawn eggs, /summon, breeding and structure spawning are all blocked (existing mobs are untouched, and dimension travel, chunk loading and conversions such as curing a zombie villager still work). Maintain the list with /ec c MobNoSpawn <entityId> true|false, or /ec c MobNoSpawn reset to clear it.
setting.PortalBinding.desc: Force-bind an Overworld region and a Nether region. Entering either side teleports to the other, skipping vanilla portal search.
setting.PortalBindingEnhanced.desc: When enabled, bound teleportation skips the target portal check and teleports directly to the bound coordinates.
setting.box_crafting.desc: When enabled, a shulker box full of the same item can be used as that item in crafting; outputs are boxed and box count is conserved. If there aren't enough empty boxes, outputs are placed unboxed into your inventory (overflow drops). Default: OFF.
setting.infinite_shear.desc: Sheep regain their wool immediately after being sheared, allowing infinite shearing.
setting.no_brain_on_portal.desc: Monsters lose their AI after passing through a Nether portal.
setting.piglin_barter_delay.desc: Adjust the time piglins examine gold before bartering (vanilla: 6s). Gold blocks automatically use 9x this value.
setting.piglin_gold_block_multiply.desc: Piglins accept gold blocks. 1 block triggers a single trade, but the output is multiplied by 9.
setting.piglin_gold_block_multiply_punis: Piglin Gold Block Barter Punishment Time
Controls the duration of the Piglin gold block barter punishment. Options: 1, 3, 9. Higher values mean longer punishment time. Default: 9.
setting.tnt_no_destroy_drops.desc: When enabled, TNT explosions will not destroy dropped items on the ground. Default: OFF.
setting.villager_auto_lock_hit_trader.de: Automatically lock the villager's trade after refreshing an enchanted book via the auto-refresh rule.
setting.villager_auto_trader.desc: Write the target enchantment on a name tag and right-click a librarian to automatically refresh a max-level trade with that enchantment.
setting.villager_batch_bed_reset.desc: Use a leash named 'tool' to select an area with left/right-click, then run /ec c bindAreaBeds to bind villagers to their nearest beds.
setting.villager_bed_reset.desc: Use a leash named 'bed' to sneak-right-click a villager and a bed to change the villager's bound bed.
setting.villager_bookshelf_decompose.des: Allow paying villagers with bookshelves, automatically decomposed into books.
setting.villager_emerald_decompose.desc: Allow paying villagers with emerald blocks, automatically decomposed into emeralds.
setting.villager_god_tools.desc: Use name tags '331a' / '331b' to spawn triple-enchanted diamond tools.
setting.villager_hard_working.desc: Adjust the restock amount per villager (default is double restock).
setting.villager_move_controller.desc: Use a leash named 'move' to sneak-right-click a villager and a target position to make the villager move there.
setting.villager_no_squeeze.desc: Specified entities do not participate in entity squeezing and take no squeeze damage. Separate IDs with commas.
setting.villager_one_tick_trader_count.d: Adjust the per-tick refresh count of the auto-refresh trader.
setting.villager_silent_auto_reroll_trad: Automatically remove the name tag after using the auto-refresh rule.
setting.villager_terracotta_trader.desc: Use a name tag named after a terracotta color to spawn both the corresponding terracotta and glazed terracotta.
setting.villager_toolsmith_exchange.desc: Change the toolsmith's diamond-for-emerald trade into emerald-for-diamond.
setting.villager_work_block_reset.desc: Use a leash named 'work' to sneak-right-click a villager and a block to change the villager's bound work block.
setting.zombie_villager_help.desc: Apply a name tag named 'help' to a zombie villager to turn it back into a villager instantly (profession, trades and gossip are kept).
villagerdetails.rule.villagerbonemealflo: Bone meal on grass blocks ignores biome and generates overworld flowers (Overworld only)
villagerdetails.ui.keybind.listening.hin: Hold several keys to bind a combo (e.g. hold X then press C). ESC clears this binding; a left-click on empty space keeps it.
villagerdetails.ui.list.add.hint: Type a value, click empty space to save…
villagerdetails.ui.list.invalid: §cNot a valid ID (no such registry entry, tag or registry)
villagerdetails.ui.option.bb_box_color.d: Highlight color of the region box when both corners are selected
villagerdetails.ui.option.bb_highlight_l: Thickness of each line of the BB selection highlight box. Higher values draw thicker lines.
Highlight color of the first BB selector corner
Highlight color of the second BB selector corner
villagerdetails.ui.option.bed_list.desc: A list of beds. Click the button on the right to add/remove entries; the row previews up to two.
villagerdetails.ui.option.clear_bb_selec: Click to clear the selection on both client and server. The client sends a request instead of clearing locally; the server drops its authoritative cache and pushes the empty state back, so the highlight disappears via sync.
villagerdetails.ui.option.clear_eb_selec: Click to clear the entity / block selection on both client and server. The client sends a request instead of clearing locally; the server drops its authoritative cache and pushes the empty state back, so the highlight disappears via sync.
villagerdetails.ui.option.clear_portal_v: Click to clear the temporary portal-region highlight sent by clicking a Show entry: both the overworld and the nether side are cleared, so no box is left behind. Client-only view; does not affect any binding data.
villagerdetails.ui.option.eb_highlight_l: Thickness of each line of the EB entity / block highlight box. Higher values draw thicker lines.
villagerdetails.ui.option.far_color.desc: Line color once the villager is farther than the threshold. Click the gear to edit R/G/B sliders.
villagerdetails.ui.option.far_distance.d: Once a villager is farther than this from its bed, the line switches to the alert color.
villagerdetails.ui.option.highlight_regi: How many blocks the two-corner region highlight box expands outward. A larger gap reduces Z-fighting flicker where it shares a plane with the corner block boxes.
villagerdetails.ui.option.line_width.des: Thickness of the line. Higher values draw thicker lines.
villagerdetails.ui.option.near_color.des: Line color while the villager is within the distance threshold. Click the gear to edit R/G/B sliders.
villagerdetails.ui.option.portal_highlig: Thickness of each line of the portal region highlight box. Higher values draw thicker lines.
villagerdetails.ui.option.portal_view_ne: Color of the nether-side region box when a Show entry is highlighted.
villagerdetails.ui.option.portal_view_ow: Color of the overworld-side region box when a Show entry is highlighted.
villagerdetails.ui.option.render_bb_high: Whether to highlight the BB selector's block / region on the client (local only)
villagerdetails.ui.option.render_bed_lin: Draws a line between a villager and the bed it is bound to. Turn off to hide all lines.
villagerdetails.ui.option.render_selecti: Whether to highlight the entity / block selected by the EB selector on the client (local only)
villagerdetails.ui.option.selected_block: Color of the client-side highlight box when the EB selector picks a block
villagerdetails.ui.option.selected_entit: Color of the client-side highlight box when the EB selector picks an entity
villagerdetails.ui.rule.no_permission: §cYou do not have permission to change server rules

villagerdetails.ui.rule_data.toggle: Current value of this entry: yes / no. Setting it to "no" removes it from the list.
